subject.title: Proposal: accept optional exact-head proof packets as review input

question: Should one fenced `clawsweeper-proof` JSON block in the PR body become ClawSweeper’s supported v1 contract for head-bound contributor proof metadata?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the gap and a bounded implementation path, but only maintainers can commit the project to a durable public syntax, schema, and compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve bounded packet
options.body: Support one versioned and size-limited block, fail closed on malformed or duplicate input, classify its head as current or stale, and never let the packet alone satisfy proof.

options.title: Retain free-form proof
options.body: Decline a structured contributor contract and continue passing descriptions, comments, and artifacts directly to model review.

options.title: Choose another interface
options.body: Defer implementation while maintainers design a form, bot command, or other structured proof-metadata surface.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded packet
recommendation.body: Support one versioned and size-limited block, fail closed on malformed or duplicate input, classify its head as current or stale, and never let the packet alone satisfy proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the compact context and recent exact-head safety paths where this public contract would integrate, and merged the original proof feature.
